summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Global X Bitcoin Covered Call ETF (BCCC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long btc, short usd currency. The fund is actively managed, offering Bitcoins (BTC) price exposure while prioritizing high-income potential and periodic distributions. The fund uses a synthetic covered call strategy built on US-listed spot and futures-based Bitcoin ETPs BCCC was launched on Jun 3, 2025 and is issued by Global X.
